moves.text: | `IndNonnegative` | Value `0` at a point with no negative and no `NaN` entry (`-0.0` and `+Inf` included), `Inf` at a negative entry (`-Inf` included) when no entry is `NaN`, `NaN` at a `NaN` entry. The projection is `max(v, 0)` at a step `γ ≥ 0`: `-0.0` and `-Inf` give `+0`, `NaN` stays `NaN`. A negative or `NaN` scalar step throws `ArgumentError` before any write in `prox`, `prox!` and `value_and_prox!`; array-step entries, `prox_block` and `Scaled` routes do not check and project. `value_and_prox!` returns the value at the stored output: `NaN` at a `NaN` output entry, otherwise `0`. The tolerance of the archived value (`v >= -_tol`) is not kept: a negative entry of any size gives `Inf` |
